notes: לֵאלֹהִים fuses: one English word carries both the preposition's relation and the lexeme, headed on the noun (rules 30, 49); marking the preposition unrepresented under rule 40 was the competing reading.
The dative לָכֶם is left with nothing by the possessive recasting while its suffix takes *your* (rules 18, 40).
The article on הַמּוֹצִיא is rendered by the relative *who* and heads on it (rule 41).
